name: 金门饭店／华安大楼历史主楼外观候选
subject: Pacific Hotel / Hua'an Building at 104 Nanjing West Road

other_scope_height_statements.scope: separate north building; excluded from this candidate

estimated: The 38.16 m overall height is a chosen design interpretation; a gazetteer gives 36.16 m and the reported 9 m clock-tower height has unverified endpoints. The 40.1 m 2026 tender-mirror south-building project quantity is not bound to the historical height, while 24 m describes the separately scoped north building. Plan dimensions, I-shaped massing, recessed centre, wings, rustication, window grid, balconies, cornices, clock-tower details, roof and rear elevations are design estimates. Accounts of eight original storeys, nine before opening and ten today are different source/period accounts that remain unreconciled; nine wing layers and eight central-body layers are modeling choices. The later north building and estate project are excluded.
